discovery.title: Discover Stove Module
discovery.description: Select a module found on your local network, or choose manual entry.

device.title: 4HEAT Lite Stove
device.description: Enter the module IP address or hostname and select the stove profile. For direct local setup, the device ID is optional; a discovered ID helps track IP changes.

data_description.module_address: Source IP that Home Assistant expects for proxy requests. Set to router IP if the module is behind NAT.
data_description.stove_profile: Select Jolly Mec for whole-degree temperatures, combustion power and native on/off scheduling. Save and reopen options after changing profiles.

cloud.title: 4HEAT Cloud Login
cloud.description: Authenticate with your 4HEAT account to retrieve the device key.

user.title: Connect your 4HEAT Lite stove
user.description: Choose direct local access without an account, or cloud-assisted setup for proxy modes.

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to module. Verify IP and that stove is powered on.
error.device_key_failed: Could not retrieve device key from 4HEAT cloud. Check device ID.

settings.description: Cloud Keepalive and Local Only modes require DNS/DNAT setup. See [Proxy Modes documentation]({proxy_modes_url}).

data_description.module_address: Source IP that Home Assistant expects for proxy requests. Set to router IP if the module is behind NAT.
data_description.stove_profile: Select Jolly Mec for whole-degree temperatures, combustion power and native on/off scheduling. Save and reopen options after changing profiles.

native.title: Stove schedule
native.description:
Read directly from the stove. Checked slots are enabled; mode OFF disables the entire program. Saving takes effect immediately and the stove runs the program without Home Assistant.

{schedule}

data_description.days: A group applies the same three slots to every selected day. Other days are preserved.

native_slots.title: Start and stop times
native_slots.description: Days: **{days}**. For a group, initial values come from its first day. All selected days receive these slots. End must follow start on the same day. Unchecked slots are stored but inactive.

native_review.title: Save this program to the stove?

error.invalid_schedule: Invalid schedule format. Required keys: eco, comfort, comfort2, slots.
error.invalid_temperature: Temperature values must be between 10.0 and 40.0.
error.invalid_time: Time values must be in HH:MM format with start before end.
error.invalid_day: Day names must be: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.
error.overlapping_slots: Time slots overlap on the same day.
error.schedule_send_failed: Failed to send schedule to module.
error.multiple_active: Only one schedule can be active at a time.
error.native_invalid: Unsupported schedule values. No program was sent.

abort.cloud_setup_required: This entry has no cloud device key. Use direct mode, or configure the device through cloud-assisted setup to use proxy modes.
abort.native_invalid: Unsupported schedule values. No program was sent.
abort.native_read_failed: Cannot read the current stove schedule. No program was sent.
abort.native_unsupported: This program cannot be edited with the supported native format. No program was sent.
abort.native_conflict: The program changed on the stove. Nothing was sent. Reopen the editor to read the latest program.
abort.native_rejected: The stove rejected the program. Reopen the editor to inspect its current schedule.
abort.native_unverified: The program was sent once, but its storage could not be verified. It may have taken effect. No automatic retry was made. Reopen the editor or check the remote before trying again.
abort.native_saved: The program stored in the stove has been read back and verified.
